$comment: Perf-gate profile of phase P5 (run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile p5): the in-engine voice families. Templates are materialized with the variables below (-Var NAME=value or SIGIL_BENCH_<NAME>); a template whose variables are missing is skipped with a warning. SLOT_ZS is a Sigil-ZS slot folder (manifest.json {"format": "sigil-zs-1", "family": {"preset": "sigil_low"}}) and REFERENCE a reference clip (5-10 s of one speaker); SLOT_DDSP a DDSP-SVC 6.3 slot imported with `Sigil.exe --headless vc-import-worker job.json` (family ddsp_svc) or the voice library's New voice; SWEEP the WAV from scripts/bench/singing_sweep.py. The app data (-AppData) needs vc/zs-seed-vc, vc/ddsp-svc-6.3 and vc/vocoder-pc-nsf-hifigan-44k installed (Models tab Import, or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS), plus the content encoder and CREPE-tiny. T10 is the plan's target (docs/SPEECH_STACK_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, 'VC best engine' > Targets): the zero-shot delay rows are measured on H2 here (H1 is the target rig, scheduled with a friend's live-record); speaker similarity against upstream offline and the singing range against the intended notes need their own scripts (the family's ignored real-model tests, scripts/bench/score_singing.py), so the profile gates on the delay and fidelity rows the benchmark measures.
name: p5
description: P5 voice families: Sigil-ZS zero-shot (sigil_low) and DDSP-SVC singing on CUDA and DirectML, each with offline compute, paced latency, the load simulators and fidelity against its offline ceiling.

targets.label: Sigil-ZS end-to-end p95 <= 300 ms idle (engine-added, paced; H2 here, H1 is the target rig)
Sigil-ZS end-to-end p95 <= 300 ms idle on DirectML
Sigil-ZS p99 <= 450 ms under load (H2 load simulator)
Sigil-ZS p99 <= 450 ms under the H1 simulation (provisional H1)
Sigil-ZS p99 <= 450 ms under load on DirectML (H2 load simulator)
zero-shot voice from a reference in <= 5 s (load, reference included)
Sigil-ZS stream vs its offline ceiling: CAM++ cosine (reported)
DDSP-SVC singing stream vs its offline ceiling: F0 gross error <= 2 % (CREPE analyzer)
DDSP-SVC singing on DirectML vs its offline ceiling: F0 gross error <= 2 % (CREPE analyzer)
DDSP-SVC backlog never above budget + one block (H1 simulation with a 3 s stall)
